endAlong._note: Calibration round 53. With simulatedMembership.endAlong true, the volunteer count's cars that ended a trip along a counted street (endAlongVehPerHour of the select-link runs in data/calibration/rockridge.targets.json: Hillegass Ave and Colby St, both directions, PM and AM) are fit targets of this weight in the periods whose select-link blocks have simulated trips. A pair counts its share of trips that used a link of the run (simulated, with the static fraction as a prior of simulatedMembership.priorTrips trips) where its destination is a node strictly between the run's ends. The weight 2 is an ASSUMPTION, the weight of the ramp counts: the figure is one count by volunteers over one peak hour. The figures describe the whole street between its ends, like the route stations, so the training view leaves out a run with a held block on it. Passes without a membership file and midday keep the baseline build.

simulatedMembership.noteSuffix: Round 53 sub-switch endAlong, absent in rounds 48 to 52: the count's cars that ended a trip along a counted street are fit targets (countFit.endAlong), from the same block pairs as the shares (ASSUMPTION, no reference).
